units: Yoma 44ᵇ sq. (expl. מוּפָז, I Kings X, 18) שדומה לַפָּז because it resembles the paz.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:31">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 127</cite> <he>לפי שאינו עומד … והפז ליום הדין</he> because money and gold and fine gold cannot stand up (as defense) on the day of judgment.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 8:1">Ex. R. s. 8</cite>; Tanḥ. Vaëra 8 <he>כתם פז</he> fine gold; a. e.
